Steps: Open home, pets, a pet detail, and system status; check `/ready` using the configured API base.
Expected Result: Pages render; API is reachable; readiness reports a healthy database.

Steps: Log in separately as adopter, employee, vet, manager, and admin; open each dashboard and log out.
Expected Result: Each account reaches its own dashboard; logout returns to login.

Role / Preconditions: Adopter A, employee; available pet A
Steps: Submit adoption request as A; approve it as employee; refresh A's requests and adoptions.
Expected Result: Request is approved, pet adopted, and exactly one adoption record is visible to A.

Steps: Add product to cart; supply delivery details; place cash order; inspect staff order list.
Expected Result: Success shows an order ID; matching completed cash order persists; cart is empty.

Steps: Add medical entry and vaccination; refresh both pages.
Expected Result: Both records persist against the correct pet.

Steps: Open `#/admin-users`; call a protected admin API without a token, then with an adopter token.
Expected Result: Visitor is sent to login; adopter is redirected from forbidden UI; API refuses unauthorized access.

Steps: Sign up with valid names, strong password, and matching confirmation; then log in.
Expected Result: An adopter account is created and can access the adopter dashboard.

Steps: Submit blank required fields; malformed email; 7-character password; password missing each required character type; mismatched confirmation; overlength name.
Expected Result: Each invalid submission gives useful validation and creates no account.

Steps: Attempt duplicate signup; log in with wrong password; log in as an inactive account.
Expected Result: Duplicate signup and invalid/inactive login are rejected without an authenticated session.

Steps: Refresh a protected page; expire the access token using a controlled fixture; allow refresh; log out; revisit protected page and reuse old refresh token.
Expected Result: Session refresh works when valid; logout removes UI access and invalidates refresh-token reuse.

Steps: Request password reset; follow link; choose strong matching password; log in; reuse link; test expired/invalid token.
Expected Result: Valid reset works; old password fails; reused/expired/invalid token is rejected. Token lifetime in source is one hour.

Steps: Change password with wrong current password and mismatched confirmation, then valid values; log in with old and new passwords.
Expected Result: Invalid changes fail; only the new password works after success.

Steps: Complete Google login; separately cancel consent and test callback failure.
Expected Result: Success establishes the correct account session; failures return a usable error state without a partial session. Mark Blocked if configuration is unavailable.

Steps: Edit allowed profile fields, refresh; try an email change via API; upload valid avatar.
Expected Result: Allowed changes and avatar persist; email update is refused.

Steps: Browse and search pets; combine available filters; change pages; clear filters; search nonexistent text.
Expected Result: Results and details agree; pagination works; empty results are clear and filters reset correctly.

Steps: Create pet with valid fields; edit description; upload image; refresh staff and public views.
Expected Result: Correct record and image persist; public information matches the saved pet.

Steps: Submit missing name/species; negative or fractional age; negative weight; invalid species; overlength description.
Expected Result: Invalid data is rejected and existing records remain unchanged.

Steps: Cancel archive confirmation, then confirm archive; search again; open the previous detail URL.
Expected Result: Cancel preserves the pet; confirmed archive removes it from active lists; old URL handles unavailable data clearly.

Steps: Submit request with notes; refresh My Requests and staff request list.
Expected Result: One pending request records the correct adopter, pet, and notes; pet becomes pending.

Role / Preconditions: Pending pet from ADP-01; adopter B
Steps: Repeat A's submission; submit as B; try an adopted pet and a medical-hold pet.
Expected Result: No additional request is accepted for unavailable pets; error is understandable.

Steps: Approve once; repeat approval; inspect adopter history and public pet state.
Expected Result: Exactly one adoption is created; pet is adopted; repeated approval fails; adopter sees the outcome.

Steps: Reject request; refresh adopter view and pet list.
Expected Result: Request is rejected; pet becomes available if no other pending request remains; adopter receives an update notification.

Steps: Cancel request; attempt cancel again; separately attempt to cancel an approved request.
Expected Result: First cancellation succeeds and releases the pet if appropriate; later/invalid cancellation is rejected.

Steps: Ensure pet is available; submit again; inspect ID, notes, status, reviewer, and date.
Expected Result: Request returns to pending with current details and cleared reviewer; reuse of the previous ID is acceptable.

Role / Preconditions: Two browser profiles; one available pet
Steps: Submit requests nearly simultaneously as two adopters; inspect persisted requests and pet state.
Expected Result: Only one submission succeeds; no duplicate active reservation or inconsistent pet state results.

Steps: Approve one competing request; inspect all requests for that pet.
Expected Result: Selected request is approved, others rejected, and only one adoption exists.

Steps: Create, edit, and delete a medical entry; check another pet; refresh after each action.
Expected Result: Changes persist only for the intended pet; removed entry no longer appears in active results.

Steps: Add vaccination with valid date and optional batch/due date/notes; edit it; delete it.
Expected Result: Correct fields persist and deletion updates the pet's vaccination list.

Steps: Submit missing vaccine name/date; malformed date; invalid status; overlength notes.
Expected Result: Invalid data is rejected with a useful error; no partial vaccination appears.

Steps: Upload medical document; reopen record; download document; inspect another pet's record.
Expected Result: PDF remains linked to the intended medical record and downloads intact.

Steps: Create supplier and supply; edit supported fields; upload supply image; refresh lists.
Expected Result: Values and relationships persist; image displays correctly.

Steps: List an active positive-stock supply in store; view as adopter; unlist it; test zero stock.
Expected Result: Store shows eligible listings and excludes unlisted/zero-stock items.

Steps: Test search, category/status filters, low-stock list, pagination, and empty results.
Expected Result: Displayed records match filters and quantities; paging does not lose the filter state.

Steps: Cancel deletion, then delete a supply/supplier where allowed; retry linked supplier deletion.
Expected Result: Cancel preserves data; permitted deletion persists; linked-record restrictions produce a clear error without broken relationships.

Steps: Add product twice; change quantity; refresh; remove item; clear cart.
Expected Result: Cart combines quantities for the same product, computes totals correctly, persists changes, and clears successfully.

Steps: Send zero, negative, fractional, and nonnumeric cart quantities; test unknown product ID; submit an empty-cart checkout.
Expected Result: Invalid requests fail without creating an order or corrupting cart quantities.

Steps: Calculate expected total; enter delivery details; place cash order; inspect staff order list and payment.
Expected Result: Stored total matches database prices; delivery data is correct; order is completed with one cash payment; cart clears.

Steps: Omit each required delivery field; submit whitespace-only fields through UI; test field maximum lengths via API.
Expected Result: Validation prevents invalid checkout; optional postal code/notes may be omitted.

Steps: Call create checkout only; inspect pending order; cancel it; try paying canceled order.
Expected Result: Pending order has no payment and cart is intact; cancellation persists; canceled order cannot be paid.

Steps: Pay once; send repeated/concurrent pay requests for the same order ID.
Expected Result: Exactly one payment is recorded and order completes once; repeats fail cleanly.

Steps: Allow create checkout but fail the pay request; restore network; inspect order list before retrying.
Expected Result: Error is visible; no false success; record pending/duplicate orders and whether retry recovers. See open risk G-06.

Steps: Add quantity above stock; purchase; compare inventory before/after; change cart after creating a pending order, then pay.
Expected Result: Record observed stock/cart behavior for product decision under G-05/G-06; do not mark stock management passed without agreed requirements.

Steps: Open orders; search/filter using available controls; inspect completed, pending, and canceled fixtures.
Expected Result: Correct customer, line items, totals, payment, and status appear; no unsupported shipping status is assumed.

Steps: Create manager/employee/vet account with required employee fields; edit allowed fields; deactivate disposable account; try login.
Expected Result: Staff record and role persist; inactive account cannot authenticate.

Steps: As manager try editing admin/peer manager and assigning roles; as admin try changing another admin and removing last active admin.
Expected Result: Hierarchy and last-active-admin protections reject disallowed operations.

Steps: Create/edit department; assign and remove staff; try duplicate name and deletion with assigned staff.
Expected Result: Valid changes persist; duplicates and unsafe operations are handled without orphaned staff records.

Steps: Open Roles; change checkboxes and save; leave and return; inspect network activity.
Expected Result: Document current nonpersistent behavior as G-01; do not certify editable permissions.

Steps: Set available report filters; compare known fixtures; download CSV and PDF; open files.
Expected Result: Counts, filters, columns, dates, and downloaded content agree; no corrupt/empty export when matching data exists.

Steps: Compare dashboard/analytics totals to a controlled fixture set; change supported time filters; inspect no-data range.
Expected Result: Values reconcile with the selected scope; charts and empty states are usable.

Steps: Create a tracked action; reopen Activity; search it; open details; apply role/severity filters.
Expected Result: Recent action appears where returned; record placeholder role/IP/severity and limited history under G-04.

Steps: Trigger approval/rejection; open notifications; mark one read, then all read; refresh.
Expected Result: Correct user's notifications persist; unread count matches read state.

Steps: Open chat lists/detail; attempt send/read/update where possible with mocks disabled.

Steps: Open chat screens and inspect send/status controls.
Expected Result: Screens are read-only; end-to-end access/data testing depends on resolving G-02.
